text:
Sam: Quick runbook check for the EBR next Friday  Were consolidating onboarding health, renewal asks, and a 2-min exec "why now" opener. Who can own the onboarding status slide?
Nora: I can. Will pull active onboarding cohorts + blockers. Expect a short table and top-3 risks.
Ibrahim: Ill take the adoption metric slide (usage vs expected). Quick note: cohort C has low feature adoption due to missing SSO step.
Leah: Ill capture the enablement timeline ask and craft the CTA for renewals. We should propose 3 options (pilot extension, targeted enablement, or pricing credit).
Victor: Ill gather customer quotes for the "voice of the customer" slide 
 please DM me any NPS snippets.
asap-bot: reminder: EBR Prep checklist due Tue EOD.
Sam: Thanks. Two requests: 1) keep the exec slide to one-sentence takeaways, 2) map each risk to a single owner and ETA.
Nora: Agree. Ill annotate owners inline. Also adding ticket links for blockers.
Ibrahim: Can we add a tiny visual: green/yellow/red next to each cohort? Execs like a quick heatmap.
Leah: Good call. Ill do a 1-slide heatmap for renewals and onboarding adoption. Need final numbers by Wed noon.
Victor: Adding quotes now. Also flag: "data sync" issue still in ENG backlog (TKT-4432). @Ibrahim do you want that surfaced as an adoption blocker?
Ibrahim: Yes, surface it. Impact: -12% weekly active usage for affected customers. Mitigation: temporary client-side workaround + ENG sprint fix.
Sam: Perfect. Workflow for deliverables: please drop final slides into the shared deck and add a one-line "ask" per slide. Deck: https://company.slack/shared/decks/ebr_prep/312345
Nora: Doing the deck drop by Tue 5pm.
Leah: Drafting the renewal CTA slide now. Will propose 1 recommended CTA + 2 alternatives.
Victor: Also proposing a short follow-up cadence (week 1: enablement, week 3: adoption review).
asap-bot: calendar: EBR Dry-run scheduled: Thu 11:00am PT  invites sent to Sam, Nora, Leah, Ibrahim, Victor.
Sam: Can someone own demo failover scenarios? We need to show two fallback plans and the recovery play.
Ibrahim: Ill own failovers. Will write short scripts for each and rehearse with Leah.
Leah: Rehearsal ok for me Wed 9am PT.
Nora: Quick QA: should renewal risks include churn probability? I can add a simple % bucket if helpful.
Sam: Yes please. Add low/medium/high churn probability per account and attach the evidence line (e.g., delayed integration, usage drop).
Victor: Uploaded VOc quotes and annotated which slide they should live on.
Nora: Uploaded onboarding table and blockers, left comments for ENG owners.
Ibrahim: Added failover scripts to the deck notes.
Leah: Done with CTA slide draft, added option #1 as recommend.
Sam: Thanks team. If any deliverable slips, call it out here. Otherwise assume thumbs up and well meet at the dry-run. :raised_hands:
